QuestionStmt.S: Which cation from following develops least magnetic moment?

Solution.S:
Magnetic moment is given by $\mu = \sqrt{n(n+2)}$ BM, where $n$ is the number of unpaired electrons.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Ion} & \text{Configuration} & \text{Unpaired electrons} & \text{Magnetic moment (BM)} \\
\hline
\text{Cu}^{2+} & [\text{Ar}]3d^9 & 1 & \sqrt{1(1+2)} = \sqrt{3} \approx 1.73 \\
\text{Cr}^{3+} & [\text{Ar}]3d^3 & 3 & \sqrt{3(3+2)} = \sqrt{15} \approx 3.87 \\
\text{Co}^{2+} & [\text{Ar}]3d^7 & 3 & \sqrt{3(3+2)} = \sqrt{15} \approx 3.87 \\
\text{Fe}^{2+} & [\text{Ar}]3d^6 & 4 & \sqrt{4(4+2)} = \sqrt{24} \approx 4.89 \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Cu²⁺ has the least magnetic moment (1.73 BM). Hence the correct option is A.
